issue.title: Retire commit_finalizer_shared_clone_exempt
issue.description: Classify foreign-agent commits and already-published/pending-publication transitions in machine-wide shared clones (opened-external and sdd-kind repos) as races rather than discards in the commit finalizer's dirty-work guard. Disable to fall back to strict single-owner classification.

task_type_fields.remove_when: Shared-clone race classification has run without a real discard being misreported as a race, so the strict single-owner branch can be deleted.
task_type_fields.when_disabled: The guard falls back to strict single-owner classification and reports those same transitions as discards.
task_type_fields.when_enabled: In machine-wide shared clones (opened-external and sdd-kind repos), the commit finalizer's dirty-work guard classifies foreign-agent commits and already-published or pending-publication transitions as races.

payload.entry:
PROVENANCE: this bead replaces sase-pk, the `flag`-issue-type bead that owned `commit_finalizer_shared_clone_exempt` from its creation at 2026-08-18T10:18:49Z by bbugyi200.athena.sase-p5.4 until epic sase-pv phase sase-pv.7 (migrate) deleted it on 2026-08-18. Feature flags are no longer their own bead type, so the old bead could not be converted in place -- the bead store's append-only guard makes `issue_type` immutable after `issue_created` -- and it was removed with `sase bead rm` and re-created here through `create_flag_bead`, the path `sase flag new` uses.

CARRIED OVER UNCHANGED: title, size (medium), kind (sunset), and both removal thresholds (2026-11-16 / 0.18.0). No deadline moved as a side effect of the migration.

AUTHORED FOR THE NEW REQUIRED FIELDS: `when_enabled`, `when_disabled`, and `remove_when` were drafted in the epic plan and each was verified against the code before it was written here. `src/sase/feature_flags/registry.py` now points `commit_finalizer_shared_clone_exempt` at sase-qi.

AUDIT (sase-ru.5 / shared_clone_audit): Existing finalizer logs cannot attribute shared-clone exemptions — no operational `commit finalizer: treating` events found; the previous warnings leaked repo paths and changed filenames. Added a path-free structured event (`commit_finalizer_shared_clone`) plus `sase_finalizer_shared_clone_total` (labels: repo_kind, attribution_class, classification, upstream_ahead). Rows also append to `shared_clone_classification.jsonl` when artifacts_dir is set.

Controlled real-git races (dirty blob proven reachable from new HEAD):
- sdd foreign_agent race event_id=aede45c8734843a2a83f2bf4fb1514a7
- external foreign_agent race event_id=990fe768e12a499ba9dda011bbb3ab4a
- sdd already-published (upstream_ahead=0) event_id=2ecc1ae1e01346cc962b25a1121e9122
- external already-published (upstream_ahead=0) event_id=032e4a6067cf4e70ae43054e485ee97b
- sdd pending-publication (upstream_ahead=1) event_id=a1b03d27138a4561a0f374cd18b83cd3
- external pending-publication (upstream_ahead=1) event_id=565b7a9a01a2486bb09fc3f13459cf85

Fail-closed negatives:
- main foreign_agent discard event_id=9a3c990752fd4f6d87d5b3b05aff248c
- sibling foreign_agent discard event_id=2c639cb215864f8e987b2da7dd3ad36f
- main unattributed discard event_id=465edb04c7ed4fc8bdc815791a552a8a
- sibling unattributed discard event_id=26c8756628bc4dcb97a0fbd286a4e58d
- genuine reset: head_not_advanced, no classification event
- flag-off external foreign_agent discard event_id=9ab156db097f44d894cca9f433059dda

DETERMINATION: content-preserving foreign-agent / already-published / pending-publication classifications in sdd and external clones did not discard current-agent work and are attributable. Owned (main/sibling) unattributed or foreign-agent HEAD moves and genuine resets remain fail-closed. Residual: the On path still classifies any unattributed sdd/external HEAD-advance as published even when dirty blobs are not absorbed (existing sync-rebase tests). pluggable_finalizers On (`builtin@commit`) does not currently call discarded_dirty_work_evidence, so live production with that beta does not emit these events.
